input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Sections 11.2 and 11.3 already deliver the data-return and certified-deletion elements of the preferred position (return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, deletion certified by an officer after Customer confirms return). However, Section 11.1 sits squarely in walk-away territory: it mandates immediate permanent deletion of Customer Data on termination with no export or migration support, and it provides no transition assistance period at all (neither 6 months preferred nor 90 days fallback). It also directly contradicts 11.2/11.3, creating a real risk that Vendor deletes our data before any export. Smallest fix is to replace 11.1 with a six-month transition-assistance obligation at Vendor's then-current rates and subordinate deletion to Sections 11.2 and 11.3; 90 days of assistance is an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Replace Section 11.1's immediate-cessation/immediate-deletion language with a six-month transition assistance obligation at then-current rates.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.1 requires immediate deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, which is a walk-away position for us and contradicts the data return and certified deletion steps in Sections 11.2 and 11.3. We have replaced it with transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; we can accept 90 days as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, including export, migration, and knowledge-transfer support. Vendor shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
